gold.taskTitle: Learn to knit a simple scarf from scratch
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to learn knitting as a beginner skill and complete a simple scarf as their first project.

questions.title: Have you ever knitted or crocheted before?

questions.title: Do you already own knitting needles and yarn?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs to purchase supplies before starting.

questions.title: What is your deadline or target finish date?
questions.description: Understand the timeframe the user is working within to pace the learning plan.

questions.title: How many hours per week can you dedicate to this?
questions.description: Gauge the user's available practice time to set realistic milestones.

questions.title: Do you prefer learning from videos, books, or in-person classes?
questions.description: Identify the user's preferred learning format to recommend the right resources.

questions.title: Is this scarf a gift or for personal use?
questions.description: Clarify the purpose of the scarf, which may affect size, style, and deadline urgency.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred color, yarn type, or scarf length?
